items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: So Choo Choo Berry told me, he said, 'Say, Brother,' he said, 'Calloway wants to see you.'

ctx.x: And Choo Choo Berry was sitting in the lobby. So Choo Choo Berry told me, he said, 'Say, Brother,' he said, 'Calloway wants to see you.' And I said, 'Yeah?' And he said, 'Yeah,' he said, 'come over to the Adams Theater tomorrow.'
That's over in Newark, New Jersey?
